'''Spek-Man''' was a [[Near-Human]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]], who worked for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a member of [[Sleeper Cell V-16]], a Rebel [[sleeper cell]] that was active on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malthor]] around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

==Biography==
Spek-Man lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malthor]], where he worked as a machinesmith and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] programmer. He disliked the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and so joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] sometime before [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. He served as a part-time operative and later helped [[Berren Sid Té]] set up [[Sleeper Cell V-16]]. In the process, Sid learned the identity of Spek-Man and knew how to get in contact with him but never bothered to figure out where he lived. Spek-Man would program or reprogram droids for the cell and only asked for spare parts or food in return.<ref name="CRO" />

==Personality and traits==
Spek-Man spoke using abbreviations and [[Binary/Legends|droidspeak]] and also had a very short attention span. He was considered very unusual and was often very difficult to talk to due to his unusual speech patterns.<ref name="CRO" />

==Skills and abilities==
Spek-Man was very skilled at repairs and specialized in fixing droids. He was also talented at repairing armor, ground vehicles, [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles, [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Computer/Legends|computers]]. He was also skilled at surviving in the wild outskirts of Malthor.<ref name="CRO" />

==Equipment==
Spek-man had a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] arm and leg. He also carried a variety of tools on him at all times as well as a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. He had a storage area where he had several repaired and refurbished droids, especially [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droids]] as well as a number of miscellaneous junk parts.<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Spek-Man was designed by [[Ed Stark|Ted Stark]] for ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1994]]. He was illustrated by [[Brian Schomburg]].
